title: Implement KMP pattern matching in Rust
description: Greenfield Rust task: implement build_failure (KMP partial match table) and kmp_search that returns all start indices of pattern occurrences in text (including overlapping).

required_artifacts: build_failure correctly builds partial match table for any pattern
kmp_search resets j to fail[j-1] after each match (supports overlapping)
kmp_search handles empty text and empty pattern edge cases
Single-char pattern returns all occurrence indices
followup_prompts: Run `cargo test` and show me which tests are passing and which are still failing. Fix any failures — pay attention to edge cases like empty input, boundary values, and error conditions.
Final check: run `cargo test` one more time. All tests must be green. If anything is still failing, trace through the failing assertion and fix it now.
